profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Adobe
profile.summary: Using data science to create tools that improve how we engineer software

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Architect, implement, and maintain multiple React micro-frontends and their respective Java REST micro services while also maintaining legacy PHP code.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
POC multiple strategies for engineering productivity including advanced engineering metrics and implementations of academic ML research to automate defect triage and localization. As part of this, I maintained the infrastructure (data collection, storage, and reporting) of the advanced metrics and data needed for these efforts.

These efforts led to co-authoring multiple papers on advanced testing techniques at IEEE/ACM conferences.

positions.title: Analytics Developer
positions.description:
Implemented advanced test techniques and led organization to integrate test automation with CI / CD framework

Pioneered distributed environments using Docker containerization and maintained the orchestration clusters (DC/OS & Kubernetes).

Mined and visualized Halstead/McCabe metrics to quantify failures in engineering lifecycle

Also participated in experimental beacon tracking analytics using IR and BLE to collect data and store in AWS
positions.insights: Test Automation, Test Automation Framework and +3 skills

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
Worked closely with customers to understand and implement relevant use-case scenarios
Automated tests using soapUI and Parasoft SOAtest scripts
Analyzed and provided feedback to improve implementation of business processes
Provided feedback and support to change quality assurance paradigm
Standardized test case design methods for functional and automated testing
Collaborated with developers to create, review, and execute robust test cases

positions.title: Accounting Clerk, Consultant
positions.description:
Maintained and created JS test scripts for database and purchasing applications
Ensured data integrity using Oracle and SAP tools
Improved quality by preparing test cases from analysis of business processes in production
Daily accounting of incoming deposits to appropriate accounts
Accurately followed and implemented cash controls for incoming daily cash deposits
Assisted University Cashiering Administrator execute new deposit procedure for campus locations
Reconciled accounts and developed Excel spreadsheets to expedite account reconciliations

honors.title: Eagle Scout Award
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · Jan 2007

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
volunteerExperiences.description:
Supervised and regularly trained 25+ representatives on principles of planning and teamwork
Manage financial operations for Albania Mission and pertaining Mission District
Prepare, reconcile and submit financial reports to main offices and supervisors
Manage, negotiate and improve business relationships with suppliers and service providers
